title: A sectionwise scalar pushout acts uniquely on a balanced tensor sheaf
statement:
Let C be a category with a Grothendieck topology J and sheafification of abelian presheaves, with the locally bijective criterion. Let A,B,R,T be sheaves of commutative rings, a:A→R, b:A→B, c:R→T and d:B→T, and M an R-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose for every object U there is a ring equivalence e_U:B(U)⊗_{A(U)}R(U)≃T(U) taking s⊗r to d(s)c(r). Let N be extension along b of M restricted along a [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. There is a unique family of T(U)-module structures on N(U) compatible with restriction, whose d(B)-action is the original B-action and whose c(r)-action on the sheafification image of s⊗x is the image of s⊗(r x). Neither finite freeness nor a nonzero ring hypothesis is required.

theorem tensorPushoutAction_existsUnique (e : ∀ U : Cᵒᵖ,
    letI := (b.hom.app U).hom.toAlgebra
    letI := (a.hom.app U).hom.toAlgebra
    B.obj.obj U ⊗[A.obj.obj U] R.obj.obj U ≃+* T.obj.obj U)
    (he : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (s : B.obj.obj U) (r : R.obj.obj U),
      letI := (b.hom.app U).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (a.hom.app U).hom.toAlgebra
      e U (s ⊗ₜ[A.obj.obj U] r) = d.hom.app U s * c.hom.app U r) :
    let M' := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map a)).obj M
    let N := SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsOfUniverses b M'
    let P := SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheafOfUniverses b M'
    let φ := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
      ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
        (𝟙 ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj B).obj)).unit.app P)
    ∃! K : ∀ U : Cᵒᵖ, Module (T.obj.obj U) (N.val.obj U),
      (∀ ⦃U V : Cᵒᵖ⦄ (f : U ⟶ V) (z : T.obj.obj U) (x : N.val.obj U),
        N.val.map f (@SMul.smul _ _ (K U).toSMul z x) =
          @SMul.smul _ _ (K V).toSMul (T.obj.map f z) (N.val.map f x)) ∧
      (∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (s : B.obj.obj U) (x : N.val.obj U),
        @SMul.smul _ _ (K U).toSMul (d.hom.app U s) x = s • x) ∧
      ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (r : R.obj.obj U) (s : B.obj.obj U) (x : M.val.obj U),
        @SMul.smul _ _ (K U).toSMul (c.hom.app U r)
          (φ.app U (s ⊗ₜ[A.obj.obj U, (b.hom.app U).hom] x)) =
        φ.app U (s ⊗ₜ[A.obj.obj U, (b.hom.app U).hom] (r • x))

proof.text: Map B⊗_A R into the endomorphism ring of B⊗_A M using the R-action on M. On pure tensors its action is (s⊗r)(t⊗x)=st⊗rx. Transport it through each e_U. Double tensor induction and naturality of c,d show that restrictions are semilinear. Taking r=1 identifies the original B-action.

The underlying abelian presheaf has the prescribed tensor sheaf as its sheafification. Descend the new action through the locally bijective unit using PresheafOfModules.Sheafify.module. The unit intertwines the action. Locally lifting sections proves the B-normalization, and the pure tensor formula proves the R-normalization. For any other normalized action, double tensor induction shows that the same unit intertwines all T-scalars. The uniqueness of a sheafified scalar product makes the two actions equal, and Module.ext' identifies the module structures.
